purpose: Continuer à apprendre de cours de théâtre, réalisation cinéma et cinematic design sans copier une performance, une scène ou un acteur.
study_questions: What is the character physically trying to make happen?
What changes before the line is spoken?
Who owns the center, exit, object or eye line?
What does the listener do while not speaking?
Where does stillness become more expressive than motion?
Why does the camera move or cut at this exact moment?
Could the same information be staged with fewer gestures?
If interactive, how is control returned without confusion?
promotion_rule: Une observation devient une règle LITD seulement si elle améliore lisibilité, vérité dramatique ou continuité interactive sans contredire la Physical Bible ni l'Art Bible.
